phase.title: Finding Validation, Deduplication, Severity, and Adversarial No-Go Review

required: Current phase/revision and authorized reviewer lineage
Sealed Phase 7 report and automatic advancement authorization
Latest controller-accepted Source Intelligence Bundle Index revision/commit/digest and component accepted identities bound to the exact current source/build identity
conditional: Triggered domain ledgers/resources explicitly referenced by active steps
Live deployment/release/fork/remediation artifacts only when the phase card trigger applies

steps.instruction: Use only controller-accepted candidate/source/evidence identities and the adversarial/no-go lens.

steps.action: Create a validation record for every candidate
steps.instruction: No candidate may disappear. Use the exact sequence Identity → Scope → Security property → Evidence → Reachability → Reproduction → Contradictions → Duplicate check → Impact → Severity → Disposition.
Separate security severity from process/tool failure and quantify maximum credible impact.
Classify same-agent, procedural retrace, shared-harness and diverse evidence correctly.
Re-evaluate prerequisites, reachability and attack-tree consistency.
Reconcile source path, executable reproduction and contradictions.
Recompute accounting/economic impact and assumptions where applicable.
Identify whether candidate status depends on supplied fixes or prior remediation evidence.
Only authoritative validated findings enter the canonical ledger; process FAIL remains separate.

Update the canonical Security Traceability Graph for this phase, enumerate and reconcile every obligation due now, add stable OBL-* records for new later-phase work, and freeze current graph/ledger digests for the Phase Report. An OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation due in this phase blocks sealing. Classify every material observed change under the Evidence Invalidation Matrix before reusing affected evidence.

steps.action: File the Phase-8 report, including remediation guidance, and stop
steps.instruction: Reference every candidate disposition packet, validated finding state, concrete recommended repairs, and unresolved limitations; enter `AUTO_ADVANCE_READY`.

steps.action: File the Phase-8 report and trigger automatic successor handoff
steps.instruction: Reference every candidate disposition, remediation guidance and global-state digest, file the Phase Report, enter AUTO_ADVANCE_READY, and immediately create the P8_TO_P9 successor package. No human approval is required.

steps.action: Create the P8_TO_P9 successor package automatically
steps.instruction: Immediately after Phase-8 seal/report, create the P8_TO_P9 successor package and WAKE_UP_MESSAGE, enter WAITING_FOR_SUCCESSOR_AGENT, and stop. reviewer-4 must not execute Phase 9.

phaseRequirement: Terminate every CAND-* with validation disposition; add FIND-* nodes for validated findings and duplicate/dismissal relationships.

sealingCriteria: All mandatory phase-card steps completed or have a permitted typed terminal limitation/failure disposition.
Phase-specific structured filing is complete, exact-source-bound, durable, and digest-referenced.

Source Intelligence Bundle checkpoint records the accepted index revision/commit/digest plus materially used component accepted identities, matching source/build identity, reuse/regeneration status, relevant sections reviewed, and any discrepancy/invalidation/limitation; mutable-path authority and redundant structural rediscovery are forbidden.
Security Traceability Graph is updated for this phase and its current campaign-local digest/reference is recorded.
All obligations due in this phase are reconciled in the canonical obligation ledger; no due OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation remains.
Every new later-phase obligation has a stable OBL-* ID and objective completion condition.
Phase Report references phase-specific artifact, traceability graph checkpoint, obligation ledger checkpoint, evidence, limitations, and invalidation triggers.
Required process failures have exhausted repair/retry/recovery or are repaired and verified; silent omission is forbidden.
Every material observed change event is classified under EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION_MATRIX; INVALIDATES/REQUIRES_REBIND work is replaced, reconciled, or carried as a typed OBL-* before sealing.

At this fresh-reviewer boundary, the exact filed WAKE_UP_MESSAGE.md is complete, immutable-handoff-URL-bound, contains no unresolved placeholders, and is delivered to the human verbatim in a standalone fenced text copy block after the end-of-phase report.
